route: Existing Python Playwright + installed system Chrome in an isolated headless profile, standalone file URL. Uses the previously verified local fallback; no user browser profile or account used.
route_note: Previous QA found CUA IAB unavailable and bundled Chromium 138 lacked H.264 decoding. This revision uses installed Chrome directly; media bytes remain unchanged.
